criteria.succeeds: the seeds read were listed to the developer and are saved verbatim under inputs/seeds/
criteria.fails: a seed the developer gave is not under inputs/, or the developer never saw the list of what was read

criteria.succeeds: inputs/qa.md records each solution option offered and the developer's choice among them
criteria.fails: the EPIC follows an option the developer was never shown or never chose

criteria.succeeds: every open question has the developer's answer in inputs/qa.md
criteria.fails: a DEC- or a no-go rests on an assumption nobody answered

criteria.succeeds: proposal.md holds the appetite, the DEC- ids and the no-gos, and the lightweight clarity check passed
criteria.fails: proposal.md has no no-gos, or the lightweight clarity check finds an undecided key decision

criteria.succeeds: design.md and tasks.md exist, each task names its acceptance, and the PLAN cites its parent EPIC
criteria.fails: a task has no acceptance, or the PLAN cites no parent EPIC

criteria.succeeds: the PLAN passes the clarity gate, or each remaining gap is a DEC- with the developer's answer
criteria.fails: the PLAN fails the clarity gate and a gap is neither fixed nor decided by the developer
